items.title: George Pickens: Expected to practice Wednesday
items.text:
Pickens (hamstring) is expected to take part in Wednesday's practice, Joe Hoyt of The Dallas Morning News reports.

items.text:

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Could return in 2-to-3 weeks
items.text:
Jacobs will undergo surgery on his broken right ring finger later this week and could be cleared to play in as soon as 2-to-3 weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Willis: Expected back this season
items.text:
Though Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Wednesday that he doesn't have a timetable for the potential return of Willis (abdomen), he does expect the QB back at some point this season, Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald reports.
